Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear Team Member,

We value the contributions you make to our organization and want to ensure that our workplace remains a positive and professional environment for everyone. Recently, we have received feedback regarding some interactions that do not align with our company’s core values of respect and collaboration.

We believe in open communication and continuous improvement. We would appreciate the opportunity to discuss this matter with you to better understand the context and to support you in aligning with our professional standards. Please let us know when you are available for a brief meeting to address this.

Thank you for your attention to this matter and for your commitment to maintaining a respectful workplace.

Best regards,

Human Resources Department
